response.sql: WITH category_totals AS (SELECT category, AVG(remaining) AS average_remaining, SUM(amount - spent) AS total FROM budget WHERE amount > 75 GROUP BY category), overall AS (SELECT AVG(total) AS average_total FROM category_totals) SELECT c.category, c.average_remaining, c.total, c.total - o.average_total AS above_average FROM category_totals AS c CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE o.average_total IS NOT NULL AND c.total > o.average_total

assumptions.assumption: The total sums each budget line's amount minus spent; a line with missing spent contributes no value to that sum.

alternatives.interpretation: Sum amount and spent separately within each category, then subtract the two sums.
alternatives.sql: WITH category_totals AS (SELECT category, AVG(remaining) AS average_remaining, SUM(amount) - SUM(spent) AS total FROM budget WHERE amount > 75 GROUP BY category), overall AS (SELECT AVG(total) AS average_total FROM category_totals) SELECT c.category, c.average_remaining, c.total, c.total - o.average_total AS above_average FROM category_totals AS c CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE o.average_total IS NOT NULL AND c.total > o.average_total
